select info.PROD_ID ,INFO.PROD_NAME ,INFO.PROD_RE ,INFO.ISSUING_WAY ,case INFO.PROFIT_TYPE when '01' then '封闭式净值型' when '02' then '封闭式非净值型' when '03' then '开放式净值型' when '04' then '开放式非净值型' end PROFIT_TYPE /**运作方式**/ ,info.PROD_TYPE /**产品类型**/ ,INFO.SET_DATE eDate /**成立日**/ ,'南银理财有限责任公司' prodManager /**管理人**/ ,info.ACCT_CHNNAME prodTruster /**托管人**/ ,info.REP_PROD_TYPE /**信披产品类型，母子产品，单产品**/ ,PINDEX.CAPITAL /**期末余额**/ ,trunc(pindex.P_ASSETS/pindex.ASSETS_VALUE,2) leverage /**杠杆率**/ ,nvl(PARTNER.PARTNER_NAME,'-') partner /**合作机构**/ from REP_PROD_INFO info left join REP_PROD_INDEX PINDEX ON INFO.PROD_ID=PINDEX.PROD_ID AND PINDEX.STATUS='E' and #{reportDate,jdbcType=DATE}=pindex.VALUE_DATE left join DIS_PROD_PARTNER PARTNER ON INFO.PROD_ID=PARTNER.PROD_ID AND #{reportDate,jdbcType=DATE} between partner.EFF_DATE and partner.EFF_END_DATE where REP_PROD_TYPE in ('01','02') /**母产品或者单产品**/ AND info.STATUS='E'
AND info.PROD_ID=#{pprodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select rownum personalField ,accts.PROD_ID ,case accts.ACCOUNT_TYPE when 'A01' then '托管账户' else accts.ACCOUNT_TYPE end ACCOUNT_TYPE ,accts.ACCOUNT_NUM ,accts.ACCOUNT_NAME ,accts.ACCOUNT_OPENER from REP_INVEST_ACCOUNT accts where accts.STATUS='E'
and accts.PROD_ID=#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select rownum personalField ,NOSTD_ASSET_ID ,FINANCIER ,PROJECT_NO ,PROJECT_NAME ,REM_FINANCING_PERIOD ,INCOME_DISTRIBUTE ,TRD_CONSTRUCT ,RISK_INFO from DIS_NOSTD_CREDITOR where DATA_STATUS='E' and #{reportDate,jdbcType=DATE} between EFF_DATE and EFF_END_DATE
and PROD_ID=#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
